correctness.rationale: For the ordinal sum of nonempty antichains of widths n_i, all upsets are empty or T_{i+1} union a nonempty subset of level i. The order-upset implication formula gives ((U->V)->U)=U exactly when a suitable tail T is contained in V. The right-fiber sizes are 1+sum_{j<=i}(2^{n_j}-1), with nonleading multiplicity a_i=2^{n_i}-1 and leading multiplicity a_h+1; this proves Phi=(a_h+1)z^N+sum_{i<h} a_i z^{1+sum_{j<=i}a_j}. Strictly ascending exponents and coefficients reconstruct every ordered n_i; double-counting fails gives degree 1-sum_{i<j}a_i*a_j/N². Independently checked all 127 positive compositions of total worlds <=7 and all 55,615 ordered Peirce pairs, matching full histogram and degree. The proof includes h=1 and singleton layers.
